column1: # Rooms that stop being region-opening problems at the 1 mm inflation margin.
# Generated 2026-09-06 from a full relabel of all 2556 swept two-movable rooms (Amarel arrays
# goal_open      = the robot can already reach 20+ of 100 sampled goal points at the start.
# no_goal_region = at 1 mm the goal no longer forms a separate region, so there is nothing to open.
# Every label shipped before today was made at 5 mm. These 204 rooms were correct then and are
# not problems now. Do not build them. 324 episodes ride on them.
